heading: INT. HOLLOW OAK - THUNDERSTRUCK TRUNK - NIGHT

units.text: INT. HOLLOW OAK - THUNDERSTRUCK TRUNK - NIGHT
A cavern of living wood, blackened where lightning split the crown.
Fireflies drift in the rafters.
A ring of stumps serves as a council table.
Rain drums on the bark overhead.
EIRA, a tall woman with silver braids and a staff of rowan, stands at the head of the ring.
THORVALD, a broad-shouldered hunter in a bearskin, sits on the nearest stump with his axe across his knees.
CALLA, a slight healer in a moss-green shawl, kneels at the center and lays herbs on a flat stone.
BRENNUS, a gaunt scholar with ink-stained fingers, unrolls a map across his lap.
We are gathered.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: We are late.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: We are as late as the storm allows.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: The river rose another foot at dusk.
units.name: CALLA

units.text: Two feet, by my measure.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: Your measure is a stick.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: It is a calibrated stick.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: Eira raps her staff on the floor.
The fireflies scatter and re-gather.
The question before us is the pass. Do we hold it, or do we abandon the valley?
units.name: EIRA

units.text: We hold.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: We cannot hold. We have no healers to spare.
units.name: CALLA

units.text: We have three hundred archers and a wall.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: We have six hundred when the Greycloaks arrive.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: If they arrive.
units.name: CALLA

units.text: They will arrive.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: She walks slowly around the ring.
Thorvald watches her with open suspicion.
Brennus watches the map.
Calla watches the stone.
Brennus. The pass, on the map.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: He holds it up.
She traces a line with the tip of her staff.
Here. A single path, fifty paces wide.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: And the wall?
units.name: EIRA

units.text: Here. At the narrowest point.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: Then we fight at the wall.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: We fight at the wall, and Brennus commands the archers.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: He has never drawn a bow.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: I have read forty books about them.
units.name: BRENNUS

units.text: That is not the same.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: Enough. He can count better than any of us.
units.name: CALLA

units.text: Thorvald grunts and looks away.
Then it is decided. Thorvald takes the left. Brennus the center. Calla tends the wounded in the hollow.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: And you?
units.name: CALLA

units.text: I will meet the Greycloaks on the road, and I will not be gentle.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: The council falls silent.
Rain drums.
A single firefly settles on the staff, glowing steady and gold.
Eira. If this goes badly...
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: It will not.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: If it does.
units.name: THORVALD

units.text: Then you will hold the wall until sunrise, and Calla will bury us in the roots.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: I will bury you in the sweet roots, by the spring.
units.name: CALLA

units.text: Thank you.
units.name: EIRA

units.text: She raises the staff.
One by one, they rise and place a hand upon it.
The light of the fireflies swells around them.
